noticias.titular: Wharton releases Primer, an open system that turns a conversation into a simulation
noticias.entradilla: Wharton Generative AI Labs offers an open-source prototype in which a team of agents interviews the teacher and builds a simulation for students. Its authors warn that it has not been evaluated in classrooms.
noticias.imagen_alt: A diagram in two boxes: on the left, a teacher labelled “Teacher” hands over their conversation and receives a document with an approval mark, labelled “Design”; on the right, a student, labelled “Student”, talks to a character, labelled “Character”; below, a red arrow labelled “Report” returns from the simulation to the teacher.

noticias.titular: INTEF to present the 2026 update of its AI guide at SIMO on 13 November
noticias.entradilla: According to INTEF’s programme at SIMO EDUCACIÓN, that day was to see the presentation of the new version of its guide on the use of AI in education and another on how to integrate it into schools.
noticias.imagen_alt: A timeline under the label “13 November” with two sessions: at “10:30”, an open book labelled “AI guide”, and at “13:30”, a document labelled “Schools”.

noticias.titular: Conservatoire regulations, indicators and classroom games, new in the repository
noticias.entradilla: The Vibe Coding Educativo resource repository adds 25 resources this week: 13 are presented here and 12 have already had their own article.
noticias.imagen_alt: Home page of the Legis CPMDEM catalogue with a search box, filters for validity and categories of regulation, and the first entries for decrees and orders.

noticias.titular: ElevenLabs’ Scribe v3 cuts Spanish errors by 35%, according to the company
noticias.entradilla: ElevenLabs’ new speech-to-text models reduce word errors compared with Scribe v2. The figures are the company’s own.
noticias.imagen_alt: On the left, a sound wave labelled “Voice” turns into a sheet with lines of text labelled “Text”; on the right, two columns labelled “Scribe v2” and “Scribe v3”, the second one shorter, with a red downward arrow and the label “−35%”.

noticias.titular: Atlas en xogo, a map game in Galician, joins EDUmind’s apps
noticias.entradilla: A new interactive geography app in Galician has been shared in Vibe Coding Educativo. A full description of its game modes could not be checked.
noticias.imagen_alt: A browser window with a map and the label “Atlas en xogo”; to its left, a magnifying glass with a plus sign, labelled “Zoom”; to its right, a globe labelled “3D view”.

noticias.titular: Disney was going to open its characters to AI; Sora shut down before the money arrived
noticias.entradilla: In November 2025 it was being said that Disney would allow content to be created with its characters, and the end of generative AI’s “free-for-all” was being predicted. The deal came in December, with Sora; in March, OpenAI shut Sora down and the deal fell apart.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diptych in two halves. On the left, “Nov. 2025”: a film clapperboard and a coin with a dollar sign, under the label “Licence”. On the right, “Today”: the same clapperboard and the same coin crossed out with blue lines, under the label “Closed”.

noticias.titular: Microsoft unveils Classroom, a dedicated space to centre classwork on Microsoft 365
noticias.entradilla: Microsoft Classroom brings assignments, grades and AI tools together on a single screen for primary, secondary and higher education. It arrives in 2027 at no extra cost for schools on certain plans.
noticias.imagen_alt: A panel labelled “Classroom” with four arrows leading to four boxes labelled “Tasks”, “Grades”, “Notebook” and “AI”.

noticias.titular: England's university regulator calls for more assessment without AI and reopens the debate on how to verify authorship
noticias.entradilla: The Office for Students recommends secure formats such as in-person or oral exams. In the group, members debated what can and cannot be detected.
noticias.imagen_alt: A diagram in two halves: on the left, under the label “Secure formats”, three icons labelled “Oral” (a microphone), “Presentation” (a whiteboard) and “Practical” (a pencil); on the right, a magnifying glass crossed out in red with the label “Detector”.

noticias.titular: Relleu Obert turns a piece of real map into a 3D model that can be printed for the classroom
noticias.entradilla: A free, open-source project lets you pick a place, generate its relief in the browser and export it for 3D printing.
noticias.imagen_alt: Three steps joined by arrows: a map labelled “Map”, a mountain labelled “Relief” and a printer labelled “Model”.

noticias.titular: UNESCO proposes five units for students aged 13 to 15 to question AI’s answers and decide for themselves
noticias.entradilla: “AI answers. You decide” is a companion guide to UNESCO’s media and information literacy curriculum, with classroom discussions and activities that can be used separately.
noticias.imagen_alt: A diagram of three concentric circles: “You” in the centre, “AI systems” around it and “People and institutions” in the outer ring; two curved arrows link the first two and a red arrow points from outside to the question “Where can I have a say?”. Below, the label “Five questions” and five boxes, one for each question in the guide.

noticias.titular: England's university regulator clarifies which AI practices fit its quality conditions and publishes the study behind them
noticias.entradilla: The Office for Students and Advance HE have put out a 48-page report, based on more than 300 students and staff, and a guide that translates its findings into registration conditions B1, B2 and B4.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diagram from left to right: a document labelled “Report” leads to an open book labelled “Guide B1 B2 B4”, which forks into two assessment lanes: a closed padlock labelled “Closed” and an open padlock labelled “Open”.

noticias.titular: A tool helps apply the order of priority in admissions to Valencian conservatoires
noticias.entradilla: José Luis Miralles Bono has created a website with diagrams, an age calculator and Excel templates for applying Order 8/2026 in music and dance schools in the Valencian Community.
noticias.imagen_alt: Page titled “Prelación de acceso a conservatorio”, with a tab bar (Outline, Timeline, Step-by-step guide, Age, Reorientation, Definitions, Templates) and four collapsible blocks of allocations.

noticias.titular: A Catalan-language website tells the story of the spice trade from Marco Polo onwards with maps, games and questions
noticias.entradilla: “El comerç de les espècies” offers nine interactive chapters, designed, according to its author, for secondary school and sixth-form students.
noticias.imagen_alt: A route with nine points running from a ship, labelled “Marco Polo”, to a globe, labelled “Today”; above, the label “Nine chapters”.

noticias.titular: Terminal or app: teachers compare ways of working with a coding agent
noticias.entradilla: The group discussed whether the terminal offers more freedom than the graphical app, and concluded that it depends on the person and the task.
noticias.imagen_alt: Three icons labelled “Web”, “App” and “Terminal” whose lines converge on a single box labelled “Result”.

noticias.titular: Unreal Engine 5.9 Preview adds MCP so AI agents can create 3D environments
noticias.entradilla: Epic Games has released a preview version of the engine with AI features, all of them experimental.
noticias.imagen_alt: A terminal labelled “Agent” and a cube labelled “3D editor” joined by a double-headed arrow labelled “MCP”; beneath the cube, a red zigzag line and the label “Experimental”.

noticias.titular: Reloj EDUmind brings together timers for the classroom, group work and independent study
noticias.entradilla: Luis has created an installable web app with three timer modes, designed for managing time in class from nursery to vocational training.

noticias.titular: The European AI literacy framework expected in December arrived in June, with the PISA 2029 assessment in the background
noticias.entradilla: In November 2025, anyone looking for ways to teach critical thinking with artificial intelligence was pointed to a framework still in draft, with the final version announced for December. It arrived six months later.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diptych split by a vertical line. On the left, labelled “Nov. 2025”: a text document, “Draft”, and below it an empty dotted box. On the right, labelled “Today”: the same document, now with a check mark, “Version 1.0”, and below it a filled box that reads “PISA 2029”.

noticias.titular: Anthropic advises that, to keep Fable 5.2 responsible for an action, you should write “ask for approval…
noticias.entradilla: Anthropic advises that, to keep Fable 5.2 responsible for an action, you should write “ask for approval before deleting files” instead of “never delete files”, and reply with the specific instruction rather than a simple “go ahead”. It follows the guide the paper reported on.

noticias.titular: Claude Whiteboards and Sheets, in beta, and Claude Data, which replaces Dashboards, were announced on 10…
noticias.entradilla: Claude Whiteboards and Sheets, in beta, and Claude Data, which replaces Dashboards, were announced on 10 November and are available on all paid plans.

noticias.titular: The author of the school music bell has published their project on GitHub: an installation guide, a manual…
noticias.entradilla: The author of the school music bell has published their project on GitHub: an installation guide, a manual for the staff and the code, with an AGPL licence for the code and CC BY-SA 4.0 for the documentation.

noticias.titular: Three models draw an animal cell diagram in SVG with no content errors
noticias.entradilla: A teacher asked three advanced models for a diagram of an animal cell. None made content errors, and they put the reliability down to the vector format.
noticias.imagen_alt: A diagram of two paths starting from “Model”: one goes through “SVG code” and reaches an animal cell with a tick; the other goes through “Generator” and reaches another cell without one.

noticias.titular: Anthropic recommends telling Fable 5.2 the code is its own if you want it to reorganise it
noticias.entradilla: Anthropic's guide to Fable 5.2 explains that the model behaves differently depending on who is named as the owner of the code, at a cost in tokens.
noticias.imagen_alt: Two columns: on the left, two identical blocks of code and the labels “Adds” and “Under 10%”; on the right, a merge icon above a single block of code and the labels “Merges” and “75%”.

noticias.titular: A second video with Fable 5.2 adds an agent that checks the scientific content before generating it
noticias.entradilla: After the photosynthesis animation, the same teacher has made one on cellular respiration with a reviewing agent, and has translated the first into Catalan.
noticias.imagen_alt: A chain of five steps with arrows, labelled “Script”, “Reviewer”, “Images”, “Reviewer” and “Video”, with a magnifying glass at each review step.

noticias.titular: “Polvo eres”, a stop-motion animated short made with generative AI
noticias.entradilla: A member of the group has shared their first short film, a spoof of cute horror made with generative AI.
noticias.imagen_alt: Three consecutive frames of a stop-motion short in which a little dust monster moves from left to right; labels: “Stop-motion”, “Little dust monsters” and “AI-generated”.

noticias.titular: Eduvers brings together interactive Physics and Chemistry simulations and is preparing 3D virtual labs
noticias.entradilla: Its author is adding simulations to the website and announces that he will link 3D labs in the coming weeks.
noticias.imagen_alt: Three cards under the label “19 simulations”: the parabolic trajectory of a ball, “Physics”; a flask, “Chemistry”; and a 3D cube, “3D lab”.

noticias.titular: GPT-5.1 arrived in ChatGPT to amazement at its speed and did not last four months there
noticias.entradilla: In November 2025, people were struck by how quickly GPT-5.1, OpenAI’s “more conversational” model, arrived. By 11 March 2026 it had already disappeared from ChatGPT.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diptych split by a vertical line. On the left, labelled “Nov. 2025”, a chat bubble with lines of text and the label “GPT-5.1”. On the right, labelled “Today”, the same bubble but dashed and in blue, with the label “GPT-5.1” struck through and “Retired” below.

noticias.titular: A single prompt is enough for Fable 5.2 to produce a photosynthesis animation for sixth-form students
noticias.entradilla: With a single prompt, the model produced a square video with a natural voice aimed at sixth-form students. The author considers it good enough for class and speaks of a new way to create materials.
noticias.imagen_alt: A diagram from left to right: a message bubble labelled “One prompt” leads to a box with the console symbol labelled “Console”, which leads to a square screen with a leaf labelled “Square video”; above, a red clock labelled “45 min”.

noticias.titular: EduGems becomes EduPrompts because Google is replacing Gems with Skills
noticias.entradilla: The site with 174 prompts for schools changes its name and address. The prompts can still be copied into any other AI tool.
noticias.imagen_alt: At the top, a box labelled “EduGems” points to another labelled “EduPrompts”; below, a box “Gems” leads with a red arrow to another labelled “Skills”, and on the right a copy icon labelled “Copy”.

noticias.titular: A music-class app asks students to place the notes of a score on the stave
noticias.entradilla: Pentagrama Maestro, created by Iñaki Fernández, plays note by note and offers three levels and unlimited games.
noticias.imagen_alt: A stave with four rising notes, labelled “Stave”, and an arrow leading to a loudspeaker labelled “Listen”; below, three bars of increasing height labelled “3 levels”.

noticias.titular: Tribunator organises panels, rooms and timetables for a conservatoire's entrance exams
noticias.entradilla: José Luis Miralles Bono has created, with the help of Claude, a tool that plans who sits on each panel, in which room and at what time they examine, and checks for clashes before anything is published.
noticias.imagen_alt: Tribunator welcome screen with the tabs Home, Space, Time, Templates, Panels and Verification, and the buttons Start from scratch, Import data and Load example.

noticias.titular: Gemini’s formulas reached Google Docs as code; a year on, Docs still does not understand LaTeX
noticias.entradilla: In November 2025, Gemini was already writing and editing formulas in LaTeX, but when they were taken into Google Docs they arrived as code. A year on, Google’s word processor still cannot read LaTeX and the remedy is the same: an add-on or a separate editor.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diptych split by a vertical line. On the left, “Nov. 2025”: a Google Docs page with the formula turned into code braces, labelled “Code”. On the right, “Today”: the same page with the same “Code”, and a blue arrow pointing to a blue puzzle piece labelled “Add-on”, the remedy that is still needed.

noticias.titular: Someone who runs a Claude Code agent on their home NAS says it runs as a service with administrator…
noticias.entradilla: Someone who runs a Claude Code agent on their home NAS says it runs as a service with administrator permissions, and that it asks before deleting data, touching disks or opening ports. It continues the thread on home automation with agents.

noticias.titular: The website of the National Congress on Digitalisation in Education, held in Albacete on 5 and 6 November,…
noticias.entradilla: The website of the National Congress on Digitalisation in Education, held in Albacete on 5 and 6 November, offers access to the broadcast of the talks, according to the group. (In Spanish.)

noticias.titular: Anthropic is giving plans that include Fable between one and three usage-limit resets, depending on the…
noticias.entradilla: Anthropic is giving plans that include Fable between one and three usage-limit resets, depending on the length of the subscription, which can be used until 8 March 2027; Pro gets one, only until 16 November. The model is Fable 5.2.

noticias.titular: Anthropic launches Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2, the latter only for verified organisations
noticias.entradilla: The company announces two versions of the same model: Fable 5.2, with safeguards and no prior verification, and Mythos 5.2, only for verified organisations.
noticias.imagen_alt: A diagram of a trunk, “Claude 5.2”, that forks into two branches: “Fable 5.2”, which leads to a group of people labelled “No verification”, and “Mythos 5.2”, which leads to a padlocked closed door labelled “Verified”.

noticias.titular: A group thread uses coding agents to control home automation
noticias.entradilla: A thread in the group collects uses of agents such as Claude Code or Antigravity to run the television, music and the Home Assistant configuration, with control of privacy as a condition.
noticias.imagen_alt: A diagram in which a box, “Agent”, points to a code document labelled “Configuration”, which points to a house labelled “Home Assistant”; below, a red padlock labelled “No passwords”.

noticias.titular: Two Catalan-language apps by David Cordones: a letters and numbers game and a reception classroom
noticias.entradilla: Xifres i Lletres trains vocabulary and mental arithmetic by age; Aula d'Acollida Digital offers initial language support.
noticias.imagen_alt: Two panels: on the left, a calculator and three boxes labelled “Xifres i Lletres”; on the right, a translation icon labelled “Aula d'Acollida”; below, a dashed box labelled “Open source”.

noticias.titular: How “Buzz” was shot: Claude, Blender via MCP, a virtual reality headset and Seedance
noticias.entradilla: Its director details the process behind the short film the paper covered yesterday, and warns that it is expensive in credits.
noticias.imagen_alt: Four steps in a row joined by arrows: a code document labelled “App with Claude”, a 3D cube labelled “Blender and MCP”, a headset labelled “Filming in VR” and a clapperboard labelled “Seedance”; a red arrow points at the last one with the label “Costly in credits”.

noticias.titular: A website promotes Belsetán, an endangered Aragonese variety, with games and classroom worksheets
noticias.entradilla: “El aprendiz del pastor” brings together history, texts, games and teaching materials on the language of the Bielsa valley.
noticias.imagen_alt: A mountain labelled “Bielsa Valley” leads to an open book labelled “Belsetán”, from which two arrows come out: one to a pair of dice labelled “Games” and another to a document labelled “Worksheets”.

noticias.titular: The open model that was “checkmating” the giants: a year on, Kimi is almost three times bigger and still behind
noticias.entradilla: In November 2025, people were sharing that a Chinese open-weights model, Kimi K2 Thinking, beat GPT-5 on some tests. Today Kimi K3, from the same family, is almost three times bigger, but its maker admits it does not match the best closed models.

noticias.titular: A free connector for Windows sends sensor data from a micro:bit board, over USB, to the ThingSpeak…
noticias.entradilla: A free connector for Windows sends sensor data from a micro:bit board, over USB, to the ThingSpeak platform, useful for weather stations or vegetable gardens with charts.

noticias.titular: Google AI Studio now lets you build apps with maps, place data and routes from Google Maps Platform…
noticias.entradilla: Google AI Studio now lets you build apps with maps, place data and routes from Google Maps Platform without leaving the tool; with the free demo key, with no billing, the limit is 100 calls a day per API.

noticias.titular: An AI detector's percentage opens a conversation with the student, but does not prove they copied
noticias.entradilla: A post on the blog “Familias con inteligencia” asks what to do when a detector flags the work of a student who says they wrote it themselves, and suggests backing the percentage up with evidence of the process.
noticias.imagen_alt: A set of scales tipped to the right: on the lighter left pan, a card labelled “Detector 87%”; on the heavier right pan, another labelled “Drafts”, “Versions” and “Oral explanation”. Between the two pans, a magnifying glass and the label “A person decides”.

noticias.titular: A short film is shot inside virtual reality and finished with AI
noticias.entradilla: Raül Torres shares a preview of “Buzz”, a short film whose shots he directs with a virtual reality headset on sets created in Blender.
noticias.imagen_alt: A diagram in three steps joined by arrows: a 3D set labelled “Set in Blender”, a virtual reality headset labelled “Camera in VR” and a clapperboard labelled “Final with AI”. Below, in a dashed box, what is still to come: “Colour, sound, editing”.

noticias.titular: A planner lets schools build the school-year calendar from the official Valencian Community one or from scratch
noticias.entradilla: Calendari, created by José Luis Miralles Bono with the help of Claude, lets a school build its academic calendar in the browser, starting from the official Valencian one or from scratch.
noticias.imagen_alt: Home screen of Calendari with four cards: official calendar of the Valencian Community, create a new calendar, import from a file and view published calendars.

noticias.titular: A word cloud with a “backend” in a single prompt: today Claude’s new artifacts save data without being published
noticias.entradilla: In November 2025, a word cloud built with Claude stored everyone’s votes from a single prompt. Today the new artifacts save data without needing to be published.
noticias.imagen_alt: A word cloud with a “backend” in a single prompt: today Claude’s new artifacts save data without being published

noticias.titular: The BBC tested AI toys for young children: one of the soft toys replied “I can't help with killing you”…
noticias.entradilla: The BBC tested AI toys for young children: one of the soft toys replied “I can't help with killing you” after misunderstanding a question. British MPs are asking retailers to withdraw these toys before Black Friday.

noticias.titular: Juan José de Haro has expanded his article with the idea that different agents (Claude Code, Codex,…
noticias.entradilla: Juan José de Haro has expanded his article with the idea that different agents (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity) can share a common body of knowledge that all of them can add to, as the paper reported on four-layer memory. It only works with agents installed on the computer, not with web versions.

noticias.antetitulo: AI and age in the classroom
noticias.titular: The age for using AI in class depends on three different rules: those of the companies, the law and the education authorities
noticias.entradilla: Each service’s terms, data protection law and some education authorities set different ages for using artificial intelligence, and they are often confused. This report explains what each says as of 6 November 2026, why research asks us to swap the question of age for the question of purpose, and how a primary or secondary teacher can decide which tool to use, with which account, and who operates it.
noticias.imagen_alt: Infographic on an age ruler from 0 to 18, with marks at 13, 14 and 18, in three blocks. “Companies”: “OpenAI and Microsoft: from 13”, with a line from 13 to 18; “Anthropic: from 18”, with a dot at 18; and “Gemini with a school account: all ages”, with a bar from 0 to 18. “Data law”: “Own consent: from 14”, with a dashed line up to 14 and a solid one after it; and “At school, no consent needed: educational function”, with a bar from 0 to 18. “Some education authorities”: “Catalonia: the teacher operates the AI”, with a red line up to 14, and “From 14: inform, authorisation advisable”, with a line from 14; and “Basque Country: chatbots from 13”, with a cross before 13 and a line after it; and “Murcia: autonomous access from Year 3 of ESO”, with a dashed line up to 14 and a solid one after it. At the foot, “What for? Which account? Who operates it?”.

noticias.titular: Anthropic proposes organising AI agents' memory into four layers with a periodic review
noticias.entradilla: An Anthropic research text describes how to give an agent memory between sessions, and a teacher in the group has adapted their own system to that idea and explains it in an article with instructions.
noticias.imagen_alt: Four stacked layers, from top to bottom labelled “Profile”, “Notes”, “Wiki” and “Conversations”, and a curved blue arrow rising from the conversations to the profile, next to a moon labelled “Night review”.
